limits: The actual H^-1 spectral periods now satisfy uniform complex-neighborhood quartic-gap, gap/Arnold-period and quadratic weighted cubic-period estimates, including collapsed gaps. These are potential-space statements for the constructed source-normalized periods; global Birkhoff action identification and analytic action-space descent remain required.

Global potential-space gluing is now proved: one complex-open neighborhood of the entire real H^-1 space carries all canonical polynomial and cubic moments, agrees with every actual real period, and retains locally uniform complex-tail quadratic bounds. Finite-gap exterior matching, the normalized inversion remainder of Lemma 4.4 and the physical energy/frequency identities remain open.

Prove the intrinsic singular-Hill operator identification, construct the global KdV Birkhoff map and identify its actions with the canonical Arnold periods, then prove real isospectral/action-fiber invariance and apply the verified action-space descent/summation. One complex neighborhood of the entire real H^-1 space now carries every canonical polynomial and cubic moment with exact real values, signs/zero criteria and locally uniform quadratic complex-tail bounds. Physical energy/frequency identities, the -6*Id Taylor coefficient and main Theorems 1.2 and 1.3 remain.

Every actual canonical cubic period is real and nonpositive, strictly negative exactly on an open gap. Even polynomial Arnold periods are nonnegative; the level-zero Arnold and cubic zero sets equal the closed-gap set. These signs and zero criteria hold for the common all-index family and its matched source tail at every real input. Global Birkhoff actions have not yet been identified with the Arnold periods.

The energy-analytic endpoint unit root is controlled uniformly over nearby complex H^-1 inputs. Joint potential analyticity of that chosen deflated root and a single neighborhood for all error tolerances are not asserted.
Physical energy and frequency identification, the KdV quadratic coefficients giving -6*Id, positive-index Hessian transport and main Theorems 1.2 and 1.3 remain unproved.
No full repository build or replacement of the dissertation validation is claimed.

The common-neighborhood descent, nonnegative overlap gluing, raw weighted-action bound transport and positive-ell2 analytic summation are now proved for analytic real-action-invariant coordinate families. The actual KdV Birkhoff map, its Arnold-period identity and real isospectral invariance of all actual moments, including the finite central ones, remain unproved inputs.
